changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Item') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[Item]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [VersionID] [int] NOT NULL, [Active] [bit] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [StartedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [StartedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CompletedBy] [int] NULL, [CompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, [IsTest] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_WorkflowItem_IsTest] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [NumberOfEvents] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_WorkflowItem_NumberofEvents] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_workflow_Item_UID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItem_WorkflowVersion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[Item] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItem_WorkflowVersion] FOREIGN KEY([VersionID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[Version] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [workflow].[Item] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItem_WorkflowVersion] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_WorkflowItem_VersionObjectObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_WorkflowItem_VersionObjectObjectID] ON [workflow].[Item] ( [VersionID] ASC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Item') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select 1 from [sys].[indexes] i where name = 'IX_WorkflowItem_ObjectObjectID' and object_id = object_id(N'workflow.Item')) BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_WorkflowItem_ObjectObjectID] ON [workflow].[Item] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select 1 from [sys].[indexes] i where name = 'IX_WorkflowItem_ObjectObjectID' and object_id = object_id(N'workflow.Item')) BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_WorkflowItem_ObjectObjectID] ON [workflow].[Item] ([Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC) INCLUDE([VersionID]) END
END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Item') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_WorkflowItem_ObjectObjectID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_WorkflowItem_ObjectObjectID] ON [workflow].[Item] END END
